titre: Synthesis Test n°1 — English (5th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

This is my house. It is not very big but it is nice. There are four rooms in my house. We have a living room, a kitchen and two bedrooms. My bedroom is small. There is a bed, a desk and a chair in it. I have many books on my desk. I like my room very much. I do my homework there every day.

Questions:
1) How many rooms are there in the house? (1 pt)
2) Is the house very big? (1 pt)
3) What is there in the bedroom? (2 pts)
4) Where does she do her homework? (1 pt)
5) True or False: She likes her room. (1 pt)

Vocabulary - Match
Match each room with the right action:
a) kitchen
b) bedroom
c) living room
d) bathroom
( sleep / wash / cook / watch TV )

Complete
Complete with: ( bed - desk - books - chair )
a) I sleep in my ....... .
b) I sit on a ....... .
c) I read my ....... .
d) I write on my ....... .

Grammar - There is / There are
Complete with There is or There are:
a) ....... a bed in my room.
b) ....... four rooms in my house.
c) ....... two bedrooms.

Writing
Write 3 sentences about your bedroom (what there is in it).

School subjects.
Match the subject with its description. Write the letter.
1) Maths
2) English
3) Sport
a) words and reading
b) numbers and calculation
c) running and games
